tasks.title: Validate artifact-backed pull request state
validation_commands: pnpm --filter @ai-sdlc/application exec vitest run src/phases/handlers/__tests__/create-pr.test.ts -t "(reuses pr-url.txt only|creates a replacement pull request|fails when pr-url.txt|fails when the pull request referenced)"

invariants.name: open artifact PR is reusable
invariants.description: When pr-url.txt identifies an open pull request, inspect that exact number, preserve the URL, update labels, and pass without creating another pull request.
invariants.test_case_name: reuses pr-url.txt only when the referenced pull request is open

invariants.name: merged artifact PR is stale
invariants.description: When pr-url.txt identifies a merged pull request, do not reuse it and continue to the replacement creation path.
invariants.test_case_name: creates a replacement pull request when pr-url.txt references a merged pull request

invariants.name: closed artifact PR is stale
invariants.description: When pr-url.txt identifies a closed pull request, do not reuse it and continue to the replacement creation path.
invariants.test_case_name: creates a replacement pull request when pr-url.txt references a closed pull request

invariants.name: invalid artifact URL fails closed
invariants.description: When pr-url.txt cannot be parsed as an HTTP(S) pull request URL with a positive number, fail without push, PR creation, or label mutation.
invariants.test_case_name: fails when pr-url.txt is not a parseable pull request URL

invariants.name: uninspectable artifact PR fails closed
invariants.description: When GitHub lookup of the artifact-named pull request fails, fail without guessing by branch or creating a replacement.
invariants.test_case_name: fails when the pull request referenced by pr-url.txt cannot be inspected

tasks.title: Block empty replacement pull requests
validation_commands: pnpm --filter @ai-sdlc/application exec vitest run src/phases/handlers/__tests__/create-pr.test.ts -t "(fails before push when the head branch|creates a replacement for a merged|fails when branch ancestry)"

invariants.name: fully merged head blocks creation
invariants.description: When the head branch is an ancestor of the base branch, fail before push, pull-request creation, or label mutation with a no-new-commits diagnostic.
invariants.test_case_name: fails before push when the head branch is already contained in the base branch

invariants.name: divergent head permits replacement
invariants.description: When a stale merged pull request exists and the head branch is not an ancestor of base, create exactly one replacement pull request.
invariants.test_case_name: creates a replacement for a merged pull request when the head branch has new commits

invariants.name: unknown ancestry blocks side effects
invariants.description: When ancestry inspection throws, return git_failed and perform no push, pull-request creation, or label mutation.
invariants.test_case_name: fails when branch ancestry cannot be determined

tasks.title: Make issue-label transitions fatal and resume-safe
validation_commands: pnpm --filter @ai-sdlc/application exec vitest run src/phases/handlers/__tests__/create-pr.test.ts -t "(fails when label transition|persists a newly created|resumes a created pull request|passes only after the required label)"

invariants.name: reuse label failure fails the Phase
invariants.description: When label transition fails while reusing an open pull request, return github_failed, create no new pull request, and emit no completion.
invariants.test_case_name: fails when label transition fails while reusing an open pull request

invariants.name: created PR identity precedes label mutation
invariants.description: When pull-request creation succeeds but label transition fails, persist the new URL first and report it as a written artifact.
invariants.test_case_name: persists a newly created pull request before failing its label transition

invariants.name: label-failure resume is idempotent
invariants.description: When a prior attempt persisted an open pull request before a label failure, resume reuses that PR and does not create a duplicate.
invariants.test_case_name: resumes a created pull request after a label transition failure without creating a duplicate

invariants.name: completion follows label success
invariants.description: Open reuse and new creation pass only after removing ai:in-progress and adding ai:pr-ready successfully.
invariants.test_case_name: passes only after the required label transition succeeds
